name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
parse_notes: first_tested is the first dated record; earlier undated runs (spring-summer 2026) exist

verdict.summary: The lab's first general-purpose MoE workhorse, served as a live endpoint from spring to August 2026, now parked with its weights kept. First on the vision bench under Claude Fable 5.1, by a duel tie-break (its score is below that of Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion-711), and among the best of the agent-loop test; its MTP speculative decoding was measured slower than plain decoding on an NVLink pair.
